question: The Integrated Goods and Services Tax (Amendment) Bill, 2023 amends the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) Act, __________
solution:
The correct answer is __**2017**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• IGST stands for Integrated Goods and Services Tax.
 
• It is a part of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) mechanism in India.
 
• IGST is levied on inter-state supplies of goods and services, including imports into India.
 
• It is governed by the IGST Act, which is one of the four key legislations under the GST framework.
 
• The tax revenue collected under IGST is shared between the Central and State governments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was introduced in India on 1st July 2017.
 
• It is a comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based tax that is levied on every value addition.
 
• GST is categorized into three types: CGST (Central Goods and Services Tax), SGST (State Goods and Services Tax), and IGST (Integrated Goods and Services Tax).
 
• The introduction of GST has replaced many indirect taxes previously levied by the Central and State governments.
 
• GST aims to create a single, unified Indian market to make the economy stronger and more efficient.
